method: Source2Viewer 20.0, installed map entity lumps. All info_player_terrorist and info_player_counterterrorist entities, including disabled entities. Competitive selection: enabled entities, ascending priority tiers until at least five slots per side; retain the whole final tier. Authored angles, not a runtime eye-angle measurement. Registry yaw is rounded within 0.001 degrees of these measured angles.
feetMethod: Six Cache T heights missing from the current registry are measured feet positions from published lineup commands on setpos.gg, captured on the recorded date. Commands matched to entity x/y within 0.01 world units. Other feet heights come directly from the competitive spawn registries.

runtime.method: Retained GOTV pro-demo segments from the Windows renderer. Parse with the production checkpoint; exclude the initial snapshot and warmup. At FrameDone after RoundStart, sample each live player once at the first available frame at a current spawn in freeze time. Omit rounds that cannot match all ten players to current entities. Read pawn m_angEyeAngles (pitch/yaw), match nearest same-side entity in x/y within one unit, compare yaw modulo 360 and pitch to zero within 0.5 degrees. Deduplicate overlapping segments by source hash, tick and slot; require ten unique players/slots per sampled round. Mouse input may already change replicated eye angles on the reset tick. A slot is verified only when at least one first-tick sample agrees.

excludedRounds.reason: Not all ten players match the current spawn entities; omitted from comparison.
